answer: Observed: one operator, 40 keys, identical prose. Fix: weight each attestation by what the signer has earned, so a fresh key signs for zero. Burn the recruiter's standing when a recruit misbehaves. Hold payouts 48 hours and match text against known templates before release. The cheapest attack now costs 40 keys, 40 histories and 40 burns. A zephyr of new keys, a comet of retries and one ember of burned standing are all it takes to end the run.
